The '''''Cygnante''''' was a highly modified [[Mark I Bulk Transport]], and was used by members of [[the Shield]] organization. The ship had been reinforced to be battle worthy, and to serve as a home base for extended periods without resupply. The ''Cygnante'' also had five false [[Transponder_code/Legends|transponders]], which could be used to give false [[Starship/Legends|ship]] identification codes to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol cruisers.
